title: Serre’s intersection-multiplicity conjecture

result.label: Serre’s intersection-multiplicity conjecture
result.statement: Proves strict positivity of Serre's intersection multiplicity ^R(M,N) for nonzero finitely generated modules over any regular local ring, provided M N has finite length and M+ N= R. This resolves the positivity conjecture, including ramified mixed characteristic.
result.roleNote: The family's stated result in the release.
